whole_run.definition: all executor calls including inactive shadow inference
whole_run.note: Only adjacent accepted calls in the same scope; missing log pairs and phase gaps excluded. Queue catch-up can process distinct acquisitions at one HRT tick.

active.note: Only adjacent accepted calls in the same scope; missing log pairs and phase gaps excluded. Queue catch-up can process distinct acquisitions at one HRT tick.

neural_actuator_authority.definition: this inference actually published actuator_motors under arbitration
neural_actuator_authority.note: Only adjacent accepted calls in the same scope; missing log pairs and phase gaps excluded. Queue catch-up can process distinct acquisitions at one HRT tick.

state_advancement.note: Cumulative warning counts, duration mean/max and >2500us counts include omitted ULog rows. Percentiles/interval distributions use logged rows only. Fewer than 1% of all calls above2500us proves the p99 budget without assuming missing rows.

executor_acceptance_rules.FAIL: hard fault, rejected input, missed source publication, nonincreasing GRU commit sample time, active/actual-neural warning, or p99 budget not proven by runtime threshold-exceedance counts
executor_acceptance_rules.PASS_WITH_WARNINGS: all checks pass; only explained inactive shadow timing warnings remain
executor_acceptance_rules.PASS: all checks pass with zero executor warnings
